blocks.content:
• All laws must conform to the Constitution.
• The Supreme Court can strike down unconstitutional laws.
• No individual or institution is above it.

EXAM FACT: The Supreme Court is called the *Guardian of the Constitution*.
No individual or institution is above it.

items: The Supreme Court is called the Guardian of the Constitution.
The Supreme Court holds the power to strike down laws that do not conform to the Constitution.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: All laws must conform to the Constitution.
The Supreme Court has the authority to strike down unconstitutional laws.
No individual or institution is above the Constitution.
